notes.note: Speakers verified by disassembling 0711.bla: the extractor labels every leader-variant row 'Zero'. 0.152-0.166 branch on the leader (OOO, W, RX, Rider 1, Den-O, Zero, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman, Taro, 00, Wing Zero, Zeta, Nu, God), so 0.163-0.166 = Wing Zero, Zeta, Nu, God. The Japanese is identical, so the English is identical. It trails off and Dinosaur Greeed's 'Oh, but you do!!' answers it.
0.171 is spoken by the party leader (CHARA_NAME[leader]), not Zero. The script never calls 0.172-0.185, which are unused duplicates with identical text, so identical English.

0.187-0.201 are leader pain cries in the order OOO, W, RX, Rider 1, Den-O, Zero, Mebius, Seven, Ultraman, Taro, 00, Wing Zero, Zeta, Nu, God. They are not all Zero. The renderings reuse cries already established in earlier slices.

The script never calls this laugh row (no MessWinSet for it), so there is no speaker label. From context (it follows 'the enemy's domain is expanding' and comes before 'you're accessing Veda!?') it is presumably Dinosaur Greeed. Inferred.

0.208-0.222 leader order: 00, Wing Zero, OOO, W, Nu, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Rider 1, RX, Zeta, God, Mebius, Zero, Den-O (Momotaros, rough 0.222). When W leads, the script shows the name tag W (Philip), so 0.211 is Philip's calm 'Don't tell me...'.

0.224-0.238 use the same leader order as 0.208. The opening word sets the tone: mazui-na = 'This is bad...', mazui = 'This is bad!!', mazui-zo = 'We're in trouble!!', ikenai (Mebius) = 'Oh no...', Den-O = 'Crap!'. 0.227 is W, voiced by Philip (W (Philip) name tag). The Japanese base term is rendered with the glossary 'base'.
The script never calls this row, so there is no label. It continues 0.239, so the speaker is presumably Ankh asking Seravee to hold out (the speaker asks Seravee). Inferred.
Translated the bracketed term as "sense of despair" in double quotes. 'Negative memories' matches Dinosaur Greeed's earlier term (0.151).

report: 80/80 rows. The extractor's speaker labels were wrong for leader-variant blocks (all marked Zero), so speakers were re-derived from the 0711.bla branches (see notes). 0.207 (laugh) and 0.240 are never called by the script: speakers inferred as Dinosaur Greeed and Ankh. No new names.
